violations.why: The ISR overwrites ch1 between the check at line 44 and the reset at line 45. The reset then acts on a stale condition and discards the new value.
Main resets ch1 to 0 at line 45, the ISR writes it, then main reads it at line 65 and sees the ISR value instead of the 0 it wrote.
The ISR can change ch1 between the read at line 44 and the read at line 65, so the two reads in main see inconsistent values.
